title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The male player behind Lufas, an all-powerful MMO villain avatar, wakes in the game world in Lufas's body 200 years after her staged defeat. Remembered as the tyrant Black-Winged Conqueror, she sets out to gather and calm her rampaging former subordinates, the Twelve Heavenly Stars, while a Demon King and hidden schemers threaten the world (Wikipedia; J-Novel Club text via AniList and MangaUpdates).
life_message: Power carries responsibility to repair the harm one's past self caused and to look after those who still serve you.

content.note: Fantasy battles and rampaging monsters (Wikipedia; AniList Action); level of gore not documented (to verify).
Demon King threat and betrayal by an advisor (Wikipedia).
Male-to-female body swap (AniList Gender Bending 67, MU); novel review notes almost no fan service; manga not checked (to verify).
Lufas's past mistreatment by her own people and father drove her to tyranny (Wikipedia).

folkways.japan: The 'reincarnated into a game' setup and devoted retainers follow Japanese web-novel conventions and lord-retainer loyalty norms, described here as context.
